title: Esrbespoke label
description: The site's tiny label: 14px tracked capitals in the squarish label face, set solid (line-height 1). Used for section labels, nav, notes and footer lines.
notes: uses font-mono, which the esrbespoke theme maps to its label face (Saira)
name: esrbespoke-label

props.name: children
props.description: the label text (written in any case; it is shown in capitals)

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render: a span by default, a p or h2 where it heads a section

props.name: quiet
props.description: grey instead of full ink (footer group titles)
